dataReview.title: Data Review
dataReview.subtitle: In the new version income and expense come only from invoices and expense/income records; collections and payments settle invoices, and unmatched ones are advances. This page checks the records older versions left.
dataReview.applyError: Could not apply, nothing was changed: {{error}}
dataReview.completedInfo: The transition was completed on {{date}}. The checks below are for data integrity and can be run at any time.
dataReview.intro1: No record changes until you press “Apply”. Before each step a copy of the database is saved to the backups/safety folder, and each step is applied fully or not at all.
dataReview.intro2: Go through the steps in order: repairs and rates correct the amounts first, then matching uses the right amounts. Finally compare the old and new figures and complete the transition.
dataReview.banner_one: The calculation changed in the new version: {{count}} of your existing records needs a review.
dataReview.banner: The calculation changed in the new version: {{count}} of your existing records need a review.

repairs.description: Wrong TRY values, broken links and records of deleted accounts/projects left by bugs in older versions.

repairs.amountFixes: {{count}} records whose TRY value does not match their amount (the first versions did not update it after an edit)
repairs.orphans_one: {{count}} record left over from a deleted account or project
repairs.orphans: {{count}} records left over from deleted accounts or projects
repairs.orphansHint: In older versions deleting an account/project sometimes left its records behind; they appear on no page but were counted in the dashboard totals. The selected ones go to the trash and can be restored once their account/project is restored.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: USD/EUR records saved with rate 1: older versions always used rate 1 for project records, and also when the rate could not be fetched, so their TRY totals are wrong.
rates.hint: Records left blank do not change and stay here. A match between an invoice and its payment in the same currency is updated with the new rate.

matches.title: Match problems
matches.description: Matches that break the rules: payments matched to another account's invoice, records matched for more than they are worth, and matches left by a type change.

issues.type_mismatch: The match between “{{payment}}” and “{{invoice}}” does not fit their types (a record type was changed). The match will be removed.
issues.counterparty: Payment “{{payment}}” is matched to another account's invoice (“{{invoice}}”). The match will be removed; the payment stays open on its own account.
issues.assign_company: Payment “{{payment}}” has no account but is matched to {{company}}'s invoices. It will get {{company}} as its account, so the account page sees the payment too.
issues.payment_over: Payment “{{payment}}” is matched for more than its amount ({{amount}}) (it may have been lowered after matching). Its newest matches will be reduced:
issues.invoice_over: Invoice “{{invoice}}” is matched with more payments than its amount ({{amount}}). The newest payments' matches will be reduced:

unmatched.title: Payments not matched to an invoice
unmatched.description: In the old version the project page counted payments not matched to an invoice as expense (collections as income), while the account page showed them as advances. Now only documents are income/expense. Choose what each one is.
unmatched.explainDocument: “Book as expense/income”: a cost or income without an invoice (wages, receipts). An expense/income record matched to the payment is created; the project figure stays as before.
unmatched.explainAdvance: “Keep as an advance”: an upfront payment whose invoice comes later. It is not income/expense and stays open on the account until matched. If it already has an invoice, choose neither: match it to the invoice first.
unmatched.oldCountedExpense: The old project page counted it as expense
unmatched.oldCountedIncome: The old project page counted it as income
unmatched.firmTitle_one: {{count}} old-style payment record in the firm account
unmatched.firmTitle: {{count}} old-style payment records in the firm account
unmatched.firmHint: The first versions recorded firm income/expense as collections/payments; the firm account cards no longer add them up. The selected ones become Income/Expense records.
unmatched.missingChoices_one: Choose what the rest of {{count}} payment is.
unmatched.missingChoices: Choose what the rest of {{count}} payments is.
unmatched.applyHint: Those kept as advances do not change; matching and expense/income records are applied.

summary.title: Summary and completion
summary.description: “Before”: the figures the old calculation showed when the new version first opened ({{date}}). “Now”: the current records with the new calculation.
summary.noBaseline: The old figures were not recorded; only the current figures are shown.
summary.projectsHint: The difference usually comes from the old calculation counting an unmatched payment and its invoice twice, or counting advances as expense.
summary.completeHint: If the figures are right, complete the transition. Unmatched payments then stay advances and this step is not asked again.
summary.confirmWithOpen: There are still {{open}} open problems and {{unmatched}} unmatched payments. If you complete, unmatched payments stay advances; you can fix the problems later under Settings > Data Review.
summary.confirmClean: All steps are done. After completion this page is only used for data integrity checks.
